name: Completing Solstice produces a typed result, a working share link, and an AI analysis
description: End-to-end through the SSR stack: answering every Solstice question computes a season result, the server persists it and issues a share token, the AI opt-in produces a labelled interpretation, and the share page round-trips the same anonymous result from the server.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice take page
Answer the first question by clicking one of the seven numbered answer options

Continue answering each subsequent question as it appears by clicking a numbered option, advancing one question at a time, until all 36 questions are answered and an 'End of assessment' confirmation dialog appears
Click 'See results' in the confirmation dialog
Verify a result modal appears displaying one of the season types — Summer, Autumn, Winter, or Spring — alongside its emoji, then click 'See your full result' to dismiss it.

Verify the result page shows the same season type as a heading, a 'What this measures in you' section with dimension scores rendered as horizontal bars filled to a percentage, and a 'Share' section containing a read-only link field and a 'Copy' button. Remember the exact season type shown.
In the 'Personalized analysis' section, click the 'Generate personal analysis' button

Verify a personalized-analysis section appears containing multiple paragraphs of text and is labelled as AI-generated — either via the 'Generated by Google Gemma 4 31B via NVIDIA' attribution or the disclaimer that the interpretation was generated by AI, or a graceful 'not configured' message — proving the opt-in AI flow ran.
Click the 'Open share page' button in the Share section

Verify the shared result page renders the same season type remembered earlier and the same dimension scores, confirming the share link round-tripped the result through the server, and that this shared page is read-only — it shows no Share section and no Retake button.
